questions.q: Out of the box, how do the Magellans handle scanning a coupon off a customer's phone screen?
o: Works out of the box — a common till requirement
questions.e: Bench-test point 2: phone-screen / mobile-coupon scanning works out of the box on Datalogic, with no reconfiguration.

questions.q: What is the default carriage-return behaviour out of the box?
o: Off on Datalogic, on with Zebra
On with Datalogic; every Zebra customer asks how to enable it
questions.e: Bench-test point 4: Datalogic ships with carriage return enabled by default; Zebra customers routinely have to ask how to turn it on.

questions.q: Which Datalogic scanner is the lead replacement for the Zebra DS9308?
questions.e: The Magellan 900i is the lead presentation scanner and IOR's like-for-like DS9308 replacement — what we stock and demo.
